summary: This 1A Auto tutorial demonstrates no-tool diagnostic techniques for common vehicle symptoms. The host emphasizes using known-good parts to test circuits and components, then isolating the fault through straightforward swaps, visual inspections, and level checks. Covered areas include electrical faults (bulbs, switches, relays, fuses, speakers, ignition components), engine roughness (wiring, vacuum lines, connectors), fluid levels (oil, transmission fluid, coolant), battery health, and basic suspension/tire diagnostics. The approach centers on confirming whether a fault lies in a component or in the surrounding wiring or system by substituting a similar-known-good part and observing results, with cautions about safe handling when the engine is running and when testing power systems.
title: No-Tools Vehicle Diagnostics: Practical Field Tests and Part Swapping
